summary: Let a verified managed Cloud user open documentation through the existing account handoff.
userImpact: Verified users can open documentation from their profile when the account gateway is configured.
configuration: Use the same dedicated documentation gateway credential on both services.

changes: A gateway-authenticated documentation session can retrieve the current verified email at GET /api/auth/documentation/subscriber.

security: The existing browser proof, single-use grant, exact source session, account eligibility and gateway credential remain required.
knownLimitations: The subscriber gateway must support the handoff and have a matching configured account origin.
rollback: Disable the gateway handoff before restoring an earlier host version.
validation: Focused route, frontend and strict authorization contract checks.
